default_basemap: Embedded boundaries; no tile renderer attached and no tile-service/API-key dependency.
optional_basemap: Explicit OpenStreetMap streets on HTTP/HTTPS only; requires internet and is disabled in local-file contexts.
new_calculation: Tract overlap of numeric thresholds and named category choices; source-specific geographic summaries; no recalculated CHEI or new climate projections.
graphical_validation: Not completed in this environment; see qa/README.md. DOM/state checks and actual serialized-model checks are not graphical browser checks.
